topics.title: Listener Picks 'Goodbye To Soup' Song
topics.summary: During an anniversary show, Howard Stern takes a call from a listener who selects ‘Goodbye To Soup’ by Pig Vomit and Vicki Blosky. The broadcast features the song followed by a lengthy discussion about its origins including details of NBC confiscating it and a recording of Soupy Soska yelling at his producer.

topics.title: Piano, Garbage & Lauren Twee’s Troubles
topics.summary: During a radio session, Howard argues over messy studio conditions including discarded plates and garbage. He acquires a piano but quickly damages it, leading to its locking up while also expressing frustration about his wife Lauren twee's alleged drug use and her impact on the situation.

topics.title: Piano Wire Dispute and California Weather
topics.summary: During an interview, two men discuss past conflicts involving producer Soupy and Lee, who cut piano wires after being rejected from school. They then shift to discussing weather concerns for traveling to California, advising listeners on layering clothing due to unexpectedly cold temperatures and a complicated leasing company advertisement.

topics.title: Defayo Auto Leasing Anniversary Show - Uncomfortable Remarks
topics.summary: During an anniversary show broadcast by Defayo auto leasing, hosts Robin and Howard engaged in inappropriate commentary about Susan Berkeley. They made crude remarks regarding her appearance and business ventures before discussing voiceover work and income from seminars, culminating in a highly offensive segment referencing her physical attributes.

topics.title: Nutrisystem Callers and Pizza Preferences
topics.summary: During a radio segment, callers discuss their experiences with the Nutrisystem weight loss program. One caller recounts eating glasses of water daily while another lost 26 pounds in six weeks by switching to regular pizza, leading to humorous comparisons to Clint Eastwood or Ron Perlman. The conversation then shifts to personal anecdotes about wives and dietary habits.

topics.title: Irresponsible Cruise & Genetic Experiments
topics.summary: Joe Mengele hosts a luxury cruise where unsettling experiments are conducted on guests including Arthur Kitts and Isaac the bartender. The episode involves discussions of genetic manipulation, surgical procedures like ovarian removal, and disturbing racial commentary amidst bizarre interactions and questionable behavior.
